Message.Name: Login Request Message
Message.Description: A Login Request message must be sent as the first message upon connection. A number of repeating parameter groups are sent at the end of the message.

Field.Name: SessionSubID
Field.Description: Session Sub ID supplied by Cboe.

Field.Name: Username
Field.Description: Username supplied by Cboe.

Field.Name: Password
Field.Description: Password supplied by Cboe.

Field.Name: NumberOfParamGroups
Field.Description: A number, n (possibly 0), of parameter groups to follow.

Message.Name: Logout Request Message
Message.Description: To end the session, the Member should send a Logout Request message. Cboe will finish sending any queued data and finally respond with a Logout message and close the connection.

Message.Name: Client Heartbeat Message
Message.Description: Client Heartbeat messages are sent from Member to Cboe if no other data has been sent in that direction for one second.

Message.Name: Login Response Message
Message.Description: A Login Response message is sent in response to a Login Request message. On a successful login, the LoginResponseStatus will be set to A. On a failed login, LoginResponseStatus will be set to a value other than A, and LoginResponseText will be set to an appropriate failure description.

Field.Name: LoginResponseStatus
Field.Description: Accepted, or the reason for the rejection.

Field.Name: LoginResponseText
Field.Description: Human-readable text with additional information about the reason for rejection.

Field.Name: NoUnspecifiedUnitReplay
Field.Description: Echoed back from the original Login Request message.

Field.Name: LastReceivedSequenceNumber
Field.Description: Last inbound (Member to Cboe) message sequence number processed by Cboe.

Field.Name: NumberOfUnits
Field.Description: A number, n, of unit/sequence pairs to follow, one per unit. A pair for every unit will be sent, even if no messages have been sent to this port today. For unsuccessful logins, this will be 0.

Field.Name: NumberOfParamGroups
Field.Description: Echoed back from the original Login Request message. A number, n (possibly 0), of parameter groups to follow.

Message.Name: Logout Message
Message.Description: A Logout message is usually sent in response to a Logout Request message. Any queued data is transmitted, a Logout message is sent, and Cboe will close the connection. A Logout may also be sent if the Member violates the protocol specification (e.g., by moving backwards in sequence number).

Field.Name: LogoutReason
Field.Description: The reason why the Logout message was sent.

Field.Name: LogoutReasonText
Field.Description: Human-readable text with additional information about the reason for logout. Particularly useful if LogoutReason = ! (Protocol Violation).

Field.Name: LastReceivedSequenceNumber
Field.Description: Last inbound (Member to Cboe) message sequence number processed by Cboe.

Field.Name: NumberOfUnits
Field.Description: A number, n (possibly 0), of unit/sequence pairs to follow, one per unit from which the client has received messages.

Message.Name: Server Heartbeat Message
Message.Description: Server Heartbeat messages are sent from Cboe to Member if no other data has been sent in that direction for one second.

Message.Name: Replay Complete Message
Message.Description: Cboe will send a Replay Complete message when replay is finished. If there are no messages to replay, a Replay Complete message will be sent immediately after a Login Response message.

Message.Name: New Order Message
Message.Description: A New Order message consists of a number of required fields followed by a number of optional fields. The optional fields used are specified by setting bits in the NewOrderBitfields. Fields must be appended at the end of the message, starting with the lowest order enabled bit in the first bit field first.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: ID chosen by the client. Characters in the ASCII range 33-126 are allowed, except for comma, semicolon, pipe, the at symbol and double quotes.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Corresponds to Side (54) in Cboe FIX.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Order quantity. System limit is 999,999 shares.

Field.Name: NumberOfNewOrderBitfields
Field.Description: Bitfield identifying which bitfields are set. Field values must be appended to the end of the message.

Message.Name: Cancel Order Message
Message.Description: Request to cancel an order.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: Corresponds to OrigClOrdID (41) in Cboe FIX. ClOrdID of the order to cancel.

Field.Name: NumberOfCancelOrderBitfields
Field.Description: Bitfield identifying bitfields which are set. May be 0. Field values must be appended to the end of the message.

Message.Name: Modify Order Message
Message.Description: Request to modify an order. The order attributes to be modified are selected using NumberOfModifyBitfields and some number of bitfields to follow.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: New ClOrdID for this order.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: Corresponds to OrigClOrdID (41) in Cboe FIX. ClOrdID of the order to replace.

Field.Name: NumberOfModifyOrderBitfields
Field.Description: Bitfield identifying bitfields which are set. May be 0. Field values must be appended to the end of the message.

Message.Name: Purge Orders Message
Message.Description: Request to cancel a group of orders across all of the firm's sessions. Purge Orders messages are only accepted on dedicated BOE Purge Ports.

Field.Name: ReservedInternal
Field.Description: Reserved for Cboe internal use.

Field.Name: NumberOfPurgeOrdersBitfields
Field.Description: Bitfield identifying bitfields which are set. May be 0. Field values must be appended to the end of the message.

Message.Name: Order Acknowledgment Message
Message.Description: Order Acknowledgment messages are sent in response to a New Order message. The message corresponds to a FIX Execution Report with ExecType (150) = 0 (New).

Field.Name: TransactionTime
Field.Description: The time the event occurred in the Cboe Matching Engine (not the time the message was sent).

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Echoed back from the original order.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Corresponds to OrderID (37) in Cboe FIX. Order identifier supplied by Cboe.

Field.Name: ReservedInternal
Field.Description: Reserved for Cboe internal use.

Field.Name: NumberOfReturnBitfields
Field.Description: Number of bitfields to follow.

Message.Name: Order Rejected Message
Message.Description: Order Rejected messages are sent in response to a New Order message which must be rejected. This message corresponds to a FIX Execution Report with ExecType (150) = 8 (Rejected). Order Rejected messages are unsequenced.

Field.Name: TransactionTime
Field.Description: The time the event occurred in the Cboe Matching Engine.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Echoed back from the original order.

Field.Name: OrderRejectReason
Field.Description: Reason for an order rejection. See Reason Codes for a list of possible reasons.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Human readable text with more information about the reject reason.

Field.Name: ReservedInternal
Field.Description: Reserved for Cboe internal use.

Field.Name: NumberOfReturnBitfields
Field.Description: Number of bitfields to follow.

Message.Name: Order Modified Message
Message.Description: Order Modified messages are sent in response to a Modify Request to indicate that the order has been successfully modified.

Field.Name: TransactionTime
Field.Description: The time the event occurred in the Cboe Matching Engine.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Client order ID from the Modify Order message.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Corresponds to OrderID (37) in Cboe FIX. The unique OrderID. Modifications do not change the OrderID.

Field.Name: ReservedInternal
Field.Description: Reserved for Cboe internal use.

Field.Name: NumberOfReturnBitfields
Field.Description: Number of bitfields to follow.

Message.Name: Order Restated Message
Message.Description: Order Restated messages are sent to inform the Member that an order has been asynchronously modified for some reason without an explicit Modify Order message request having been sent.

Field.Name: TransactionTime
Field.Description: The time the event occurred in the Cboe Matching Engine.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: The ClOrdID is the identifier from the open order.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Corresponds to OrderID (37) in Cboe FIX. The unique OrderID. For informational purposes only. Restatements do not change the OrderID.

Field.Name: RestatementReason
Field.Description: The reason for this Order Restated message.

Field.Name: ReservedInternal
Field.Description: Reserved for Cboe internal use.

Field.Name: NumberOfReturnBitfields
Field.Description: Number of bitfields to follow.

Message.Name: User Modify Rejected Message
Message.Description: User Modify Rejected messages are sent in response to a Modify Order message for an order which cannot be modified. User Modify Rejected messages are unsequenced.

Field.Name: TransactionTime
Field.Description: The time the event occurred in the Cboe Matching Engine.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: The ClOrdID of the modify request which was rejected.

Field.Name: ModifyRejectReason
Field.Description: Reason for a modify rejection. See Reason Codes for a list of possible reasons.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Human readable text with more information about the reject reason.

Field.Name: ReservedInternal
Field.Description: Reserved for Cboe internal use.

Field.Name: NumberOfReturnBitfields
Field.Description: Number of bitfields to follow.

Message.Name: Order Cancelled Message
Message.Description: An order has been cancelled.

Field.Name: TransactionTime
Field.Description: The time the event occurred in the Cboe Matching Engine.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: The order which was cancelled.

Field.Name: CancelReason
Field.Description: Reason for the order cancellation. See Reason Codes for a list of possible reasons.

Field.Name: ReservedInternal
Field.Description: Reserved for Cboe internal use.

Field.Name: NumberOfReturnBitfields
Field.Description: Number of bitfields to follow.

Message.Name: Cancel Rejected Message
Message.Description: A Cancel Rejected message is sent in response to a Cancel Order message to indicate that the cancellation cannot occur. Cancel Rejected messages are unsequenced.

Field.Name: TransactionTime
Field.Description: The time the event occurred in the Cboe Matching Engine.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: The order whose cancel was rejected.

Field.Name: CancelRejectReason
Field.Description: Reason for the order cancellation. See Reason Codes for a list of possible reasons.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Human readable text with more information about the reject reason.

Field.Name: ReservedInternal
Field.Description: Reserved for Cboe internal use.

Field.Name: NumberOfReturnBitfields
Field.Description: Number of bitfields to follow.

Message.Name: Order Execution Message
Message.Description: An Order Execution message is sent for each fill on an order. Rather than returning a monetary value indicating the rebate or charge for an execution, the FeeCode is an indication of a fee classification corresponding to an item on the venue's fee schedule.

Field.Name: TransactionTime
Field.Description: The time the event occurred in the Cboe Matching Engine.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Order receiving the execution.

Field.Name: ExecID
Field.Description: Corresponds to ExecID (17) in Cboe FIX. Execution ID. Unique across all matching units on a given day.

Field.Name: LastShares
Field.Description: Corresponds to LastShares (32) in Cboe FIX. Executed share quantity.

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Corresponds to LastPx (31) in Cboe FIX. Price of this fill.

Field.Name: LeavesQty
Field.Description: Corresponds to LeavesQty (151) in Cboe FIX. Quantity still open for further execution.

Field.Name: BaseLiquidityIndicator
Field.Description: Indicates whether the trade added or removed liquidity.

Field.Name: SubLiquidityIndicator
Field.Description: Cboe may add additional values without notice. Members must gracefully ignore unknown values.

Field.Name: ContraBroker
Field.Description: Corresponds to ContraBroker (375) in Cboe FIX. All externally matched (routed) executions will identify the away exchange.

Field.Name: ReservedInternal
Field.Description: Reserved for Cboe internal use.

Field.Name: NumberOfReturnBitfields
Field.Description: Number of bitfields to follow.

Message.Name: Trade Cancel or Correct Message
Message.Description: Used to relay a trade which has been cancelled (busted) or corrected (price change only). The CorrectedPrice field will be set to 0 for cancelled trades and to the new trade price for corrected trades. Trade Cancel or Correct messages can be sent for same day as well as previous day trades.

Field.Name: TransactionTime
Field.Description: The time the event occurred in the Cboe Matching Engine.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID of the order whose fill is being cancelled or corrected.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Corresponds to OrderID (37) in Cboe FIX. Order whose fill is being cancelled or corrected.

Field.Name: ExecRefID
Field.Description: Corresponds to ExecRefID (19) in Cboe FIX. Refers to the ExecID of the fill being cancelled or corrected.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of the order.

Field.Name: BaseLiquidityIndicator
Field.Description: Indicates whether the trade added or removed liquidity.

Field.Name: ClearingFirm
Field.Description: Echoed back from the original order.

Field.Name: ClearingAccount
Field.Description: Echoed back from the original order.

Field.Name: LastShares
Field.Description: Number of shares of the trade being cancelled.

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Price of the trade being cancelled.

Field.Name: CorrectedPrice
Field.Description: For trade corrections, this is the new trade price. For trade breaks, this is set to 0.

Field.Name: OrigTime
Field.Description: Corresponds to OrigTime (42). The date and time of the original trade, in GMT.

Field.Name: ReservedInternal
Field.Description: Reserved for Cboe internal use.

Field.Name: NumberOfReturnBitfields
Field.Description: Number of bitfields to follow.

Message.Name: Mass Cancel Acknowledgment Message
Message.Description: A Mass Cancel Acknowledgment message is an unsequenced message sent when a Purge Orders message requesting a mass cancellation has completed canceling all individual orders. This message type only appears on dedicated BOE Purge Ports.

Field.Name: TransactionTime
Field.Description: The time the event occurred in the Cboe Matching Engine.

Field.Name: MassCancelID
Field.Description: Copied from the MassCancelID passed on the original Purge Orders message. Corresponds to MassCancelID (7695) in Cboe FIX.

Field.Name: CancelledOrderCount
Field.Description: Number of orders cancelled. Corresponds to CancelledOrderCount (7696) in Cboe FIX.

Field.Name: ReservedInternal
Field.Description: Reserved for Cboe internal use.

Message.Name: Purge Rejected Message
Message.Description: A Purge Rejected message is sent in response to a Purge Orders message to indicate that the mass cancellation cannot occur. Purge Rejected messages are unsequenced. This message type only appears on dedicated BOE Purge Ports.

Field.Name: TransactionTime
Field.Description: The time the event occurred in the Cboe Matching Engine.

Field.Name: PurgeRejectReason
Field.Description: Reason for a purge rejection. See Reason Codes for a list of possible reasons.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Human readable text with more information about the reject reason.

Field.Name: ReservedInternal
Field.Description: Reserved for Cboe internal use.

Field.Name: NumberOfReturnBitfields
Field.Description: Number of bitfields to follow.

Struct.Name: UnitSequencesParamGroup
Struct.Description: Parameter group variant selected when ParamGroupType = 0x80. Carries the last consumed Cboe-to-Member sequence number per matching unit received by the Member (Login Request) or echoed back per matching unit (Login Response). Only one instance of this parameter group may be included in a Login Request.

Struct.Name: ReturnBitfieldsParamGroup
Struct.Description: Parameter group variant selected when ParamGroupType = 0x81. Indicates which attributes of a return message will be echoed by Cboe for the remainder of the session. May be repeated, once per outbound MessageType being tuned.

Group.Name: UnitSequences
Group.Description: Repeating unit/sequence pair appended after NumberOfUnits in Login Response and Logout messages. NumberOfUnits instances follow (count may be 0). Each instance gives the highest Cboe to Member sequence number available for the named matching unit.

Group.Name: ParamGroup
Group.Description: Repeating parameter group appended to the Login Request and Login Response messages. NumberOfParamGroups instances follow (count may be 0 — the group is optional). Each instance starts with the 2-byte ParamGroupLength + 1-byte ParamGroupType header; the remaining (ParamGroupLength - 3) payload bytes are interpreted per ParamGroupType (0x80 = Unit Sequences Parameter Group, 0x81 = Return Bitfields Parameter Group). New parameter group types may be added without notice; unrecognized types should be skipped using ParamGroupLength.
